name: inspira-text-reveal-card
blurb: Text card with horizontal reveal on pointer movement.
description: A dark card where text is revealed by a clip-path that follows horizontal mouse position. Vertical divider line rotates and shifts with pointer. Supports touch. Animated star background.
use_when: Interactive text reveals, product feature highlights, or story cards where horizontal scroll/drag creates narrative progression.
avoid_when: Touch-optimized layouts where persistent pointer/touch tracking could be unstable or create accidental reveals.
a11y: Text layers and divider are not keyboard-navigable; interaction is pointer/touch-only. Header and text are readable when fully revealed.
